name: Hurler
description: The pan's heavy: the Bulwark's slot, and where the Bulwark is a wall this is a catapult. A horned dome seen side-on — carapace purple with a split elytron and a rhinoceros horn off the head — with two long arms reaching up and back over its own body to hold a Mite (`use: ss.enemy.imp`, at two thirds) above it. The load is the silhouette: nothing else in the game carries something above itself, and the thing it carries is what it throws (EnemyType.shotSpawn — the game lobs a live Mite and stands it up where it lands). The `heave` clip is the throw, played once over the shot: the arms whip forward, the load leaves at the top of the swing, and a new one is in the claws by the end. Drawn facing +x, mirrored by the game. Gameplay radius 16. `elite` is the bleached, bigger-horned version the late marking wears. The `death` clip drops the arms forward and rolls the load off them onto the ground, where it dims.

elite.description: Marked by the hive: bleached dome, a longer bone horn, a brighter organ.

plod.description: a slow four-legged step under a rolling dome; the arms rock with the load they are holding over the back

heave.description: the arms wind further back over the head and whip forward; the load leaves at the top of the swing and the arms come back to find another one already in the claws

death.description: the arms drop forward and the load rolls off them onto the ground and dims, the dome sags on legs that fold under it, the head and horn drop, and the organ goes out
